page_title: MAL 0-1 ATM | Mallorca v Atletico Madrid 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Javier Alberola Rojas has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Predrag Rajkovic (Mallorca) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+5' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Javier Llabres (Mallorca) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Jan Oblak makes a comfortable save.
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Cesar Azpilicueta is given a rest as he is replaced by Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Problems for Diego Simeone as Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Stefan Savic replaces him.
90' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
89' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
89' The game is interrupted now, Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
88' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
86' Substitution. Omar Mascarell leaves the pitch and is replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
85' Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
83' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) replacing Samuel Lino.
81' Flag goes up against Cyle Larin (Mallorca) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
80' Today's match ends for Angel Correa who will be replaced by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid).
80' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) heads on.
79' The ball goes out for a corner. Mallorca can continue in their attacking effort.
79' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) gets inside the box and tries to beat Jan Oblak with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
76' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a change. Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) replaces Daniel Rodriguez.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) is coming onto the pitch as Martin Valjent cannot continue after picking up an injury.

75' A spell of possession for Mallorca in an attempt to control the game.

70' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle and signals a foul after Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) brought his opponent down.
69' Atl. Madrid fail to score from a corner as Predrag Rajkovic (Mallorca) leaps to collect the ball.
66' Toni Lato (Mallorca) jumps into a tackle and Javier Alberola Rojas signals a foul.
63' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
62' Here is a change. Pablo Maffeo is going off and Javier Aguirre gives the last tactical orders to Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
62' Substitution. Abdon Prats did his best and is replaced by Cyle Larin (Mallorca).

61' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Predrag Rajkovic easily catches the ball.
61' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
59' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
58' Mallorca take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
58' It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.
58' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Jan Oblak has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
57' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:8.

55' Ambitious effort from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
54' Some patient build-up play from Mallorca as they look to unlock the defence.
51' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' The attendance is 20519.
48' Dangerous play by Abdon Prats (Mallorca). Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) is replaced by Nahuel Molina.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.

45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Corner kick. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity.
44' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
42' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
40' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but Jan Oblak comes off his line to gather the ball.
37' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
35' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
33' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
33' Mallorca have a corner.
31' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:3.
30' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
28' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
25' Predrag Rajkovic blocks Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid)'s effort from the edge of the box.
24' A cross into the box from Martin Valjent (Mallorca) is cleared.
21' The Mallorca players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
18' Koke (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Predrag Rajkovic intercepts the ball.
16' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
11' Atl. Madrid hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

8' What an opportunity! Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
8' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
5' 0 - 1 Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a ferocious shot from just outside the penalty area and the ball goes into the left side of the goal!
3' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
